raw:
helix 0.1.0
  Helix harness for Claude Code: lean skills, scoped subagents and deterministic hooks. Repo facts and the test gate stay in AGENTS.md (run `helix init --claude-plugin`).
  Source: helix@helix-harness

Component inventory
  Skills (2)  graph-first, hook-guards
  Agents (4)  reviewer, builder, architect, scout
  Hooks (3)  PostToolUse, Stop, PreToolUse  (harness-only — no model context cost)
  MCP servers (3)  graphify, context7, playwright  (tool schemas resolved at runtime; not counted)
  LSP servers (0)

Projected token cost
  Always-on:   ~186 tok   added to every session

Per-component (rounded)
  component    always-on  on-invoke
  hook-guards        ~30        ~60
  graph-first        ~40       ~100
  reviewer           ~30       ~230
  builder            ~30       ~250
  architect          ~30       ~210
  scout              ~30       ~250

  On-invoke cost is paid each time a skill or agent fires.
  Token counts are estimates and may differ from actual usage.
